fields.heading: How the masterclass works
fields.intro: Live classes in Vadodara, one hour a day, with something working at the end of each week.

steps.title: Pick your track
steps.text: Start with the 30-day Foundation, or take the 60-day Full program for agents, RAG, voice agents and deployment.

steps.title: Learn in person, one hour a day
steps.text: Each class has a recap, a concept with a live demo, and hands-on time on your own laptop.

steps.title: Build as you go
steps.text: You make working things from the first week: prompts, documents, presentations, a website, automations.

steps.title: Show what you built

fields.heading: Where AI saves a business time
fields.intro: Three jobs we automate most often, before and after.

items.title: Answering enquiries
items.before: New leads wait hours for someone to call back.
items.after: An AI assistant replies on WhatsApp in minutes and books the call.

items.title: Monthly reports
items.before: Someone copies figures between spreadsheets by hand.
items.after: The report builds itself from your sheets and arrives by email.

items.title: Finding the right document
items.before: Staff dig through folders and old emails for the latest SOP.
items.after: Ask in plain words and get the answer with the source page.

fields.heading: Taught in the room
fields.body: Every Vadodara batch is taught live by the team that builds the AI systems Artificia runs for clients. Classes are direct and practical: the tools and workflows that work today, shown live, then done by you.

fields.heading: Why we teach *in person*
fields.body:
AI tools change every month. What lasts is the habit of trying them on real work with someone beside you who has done it before.

  • One hour a day keeps it steady next to college or a job.
  • You work on your own laptop, so everything you build stays with you.
  • Questions get answered in the room, not in a comment thread.

The masterclass page has the full plan.

items.question: Do I need to know coding?
items.answer: No. The Foundation track needs no coding at all. The Full program introduces a little, step by step, when you build agents and deploy projects.

items.question: Where and when are classes held?
items.answer: In person in Vadodara, one hour a day. Message us on WhatsApp for the current timings.

items.question: What is the difference between the 30-day and 60-day programs?
items.answer: The 30-day Foundation covers everyday AI tools, content, websites and a capstone. The 60-day Full program adds agents, voice agents, n8n, MCP, RAG, Claude Code and local models.

items.question: Can my company get training on its own tools?
items.answer: Yes. Corporate programs are built around your documents and departments, on-site or over Microsoft Teams. They start with a free 2-hour pilot.
